patterns.label: Belize District (2), Cayo (8), Orange Walk (3), Corozal (4), Stann Creek (5), Toledo (7)

examples.note: Belize City — 2 = Belize District, second 2 = BTL's PSTN service
Mobile — 6 is countrywide mobile, 1 identifies the provider

notes: Since 2002 numbers follow a ZNY-XXXX structure: Z is the geographic/service code, N the service type (0 prepaid, 1 mobile, 2 PSTN), and the rest the subscriber number.
The full 7 digits are dialled for every local call regardless of distance.
sources: PUC Belize — Public Utilities Commission: https://www.puc.bz/
